The '''Proctor of communication''' was a title in the [[Duskhan League]]. The proctor of communication patched through a message from [[Etahn A'baht]] to [[Nil Spaar]] during the [[Black Fleet Crisis]].<ref name="Tyrant's Test">''[[Tyrant's Test]]''</ref>
